findings.title: The worshipped One and the resorted-to endpoint
findings.claim: The nominal pair places the worshipped One named by Allah and the one deliberately resorted to for need in the same subject, so dependence is read as movement terminating at one endpoint rather than a reciprocal exchange.
findings.mechanism: The Allah focus occurrence supplies the worshipped-object side and al-Samad supplies deliberate resort; exact wider occurrences of creaturely poverty toward Allah and universal asking of Him return that directional relation to the focus.
findings.reader_payoff: The predicate becomes a map of need and orientation, not only a static title.
findings.containment: This adds a one-way dependence image to the plain floor 'Allah, everyone's support'. It does not infer that incomparability causally produces resort, recast the focus name as a vocative or oath, or treat the wider target ayahs as supplying missing target morphology. The unresolved kaf-fa-lam citation in one represented walk remains an unregistered contextual qualification.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run publication anchors the two focus carriers, while legacy reader walks and exact wider target texts support the directional synthesis. The endpoint relation and its wider return are interpretive, and the legacy records remain qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The named Allah occurrence carries the worship orientation that the nominal pair identifies with the resorted-to predicate.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The al-Samad occurrence and the exact wider texts about asking Allah and creaturely poverty supply the separate directed act of worship and dependence.
branch_activations.activation: The core worship orientation and the predicate's deliberate resort meet in the same nominal identification, allowing the proper name's worshipped-entity extension to remain attached to its core.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pair is heard as naming the One toward whom worship and need are directed, not merely as placing two unrelated nouns together.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus form is not being turned into an ordinary finite verb, and no vocative, oath, or common deity reading is asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: The proper-name occurrence presents the worshipped One as the named object toward which worship is oriented.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The al-Samad focus occurrence and the exact wider texts at 35:15 and 55:29 depict need and asking directed toward Allah.
branch_activations.activation: The named worshipped subject and the independently supplied direction of asking meet in one nominal pair, turning the title into an endpoint relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Allah is perceptible as the one at whom worship and creaturely need converge, while the focus remains a nominal identification.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus name is not being read as a common countable deity noun, vocative, oath, or newly inferred target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Belirli bir hedefe bilerek yönelme ve o hedefi dayanak edinme eylemidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The predicate occurrence carries deliberate movement toward and reliance on a chosen support.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The named worshipped One and the exact wider statements that all ask Allah and that creatures are poor toward Him provide the separate direction of dependence.
branch_activations.activation: The predicate's resort relation meets worship orientation and the wider convergence of need, so the one-word title acquires a directional structure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Need is read as terminating at the named divine subject, with support moving one way toward that endpoint.
branch_activations.boundary: The causal claim that non-rivalry produces resort is not asserted, and the wider rows are contextual parallels rather than additional focus morphology.

findings.title: Compact integrity meeting the birth boundary
findings.claim: The title's compact, hollowless integrity can meet the next ayah's paired birth negations as an image of a whole that is not split into origin and product.
findings.mechanism: The registered B002 focus carrier supplies density without a cavity; 112:3's active and passive negated birth pair and the exact 6:101 offspring boundary provide the independent source-product contrast.
findings.reader_payoff: The denial of generation becomes perceptible as preservation of an undivided whole, alongside the ordinary statement that Allah is the relied-on support.
findings.containment: The material language is an added image within the plain floor, not a claim that the divine name denotes bodily hardness or a physical object. The retrospective walk's extra B001, B007, and mercy remarks remain qualified in their dedicated findings; the unresolved waw-lam-dal branch citation is not promoted to a registered branch.

epistemic.reason: A trusted publication supplies the compact-integrity finding and legacy walks preserve the anti-derivation contact. The material analogy and its wider contextual return are inferential, so the mixed source record is qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Katı, yoğun, içi boş olmayan ve yarık taşımayan bütünlük niteliğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The al-Samad occurrence carries compact, dense, hollowless integrity.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The next ayah's paired birth negations and the exact 6:101 offspring boundary supply an outward/inward generation contrast.
branch_activations.activation: Compact integrity meets a source-product relation that is denied in both directions, making the title's material boundary explain the anti-derivation reading.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus can be heard as preserving an undivided fullness while it plainly names the relied-on support.
branch_activations.boundary: No bodily composition, physical hardness, or literal material ontology is claimed; the unresolved branch citation remains outside the registered focus branch.

findings.title: A closure across both birth directions
findings.claim: The stopper image lets the title anticipate the two-way birth denial as a closure: the outward and inward directions of generation meet a single sealed boundary.
findings.mechanism: The registered B003 focus carrier supplies a stopper that closes an opening; the adjacent active and passive birth pair supplies two opposed directions, while the exact 6:101 text supplies a wider no-offspring boundary.
findings.reader_payoff: The next ayah's mirrored verbs can be felt as two passages meeting one closed threshold, rather than as two unrelated negations.
findings.containment: The title is not being defined as a literal bottle or physical container. The seal is a structural analogy carried by the focus word and the supplied neighboring denial; the retrospective occurrence citation in one represented walk is not treated as an unregistered branch.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication and legacy walk share an exact B003 carrier and the same neighboring structural contact. The stopper-to-birth passage is an analogy, and target morphology in the wider connection is absent.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Şişenin ağzını sıkıca kapatan tıkaç ya da kapatma parçasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The al-Samad occurrence carries the supplied stopper image associated with closing an opening.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The adjacent active/passive birth mirror, the 112:4 boundary, and the exact 6:101 offspring denial supply opposed generative directions and their closure boundary.
branch_activations.activation: A closing piece meets the two-direction birth structure, allowing the focus title to organize both negations as one sealed relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The title's support image also makes the following denial feel closed in both the outgoing and incoming direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus word is not reduced to a bottle stopper, and no literal container or physical mechanism is asserted.

findings.title: Endurance outside generated succession
findings.claim: The enduring facet makes the support named by al-Samad legible as continuing through changing conditions while the surrounding birth and occurrence language places generated events in a temporal sequence.
findings.mechanism: The B007 focus carrier supplies continuance; 112:3's birth events and 112:4's occurrence and equality denial provide temporal contrast, echoed by the exact al-Qayyum occurrences in 2:255 and 3:2.
findings.reader_payoff: A static title becomes an image of support that remains available while generated events enter and leave a sequence.
findings.containment: This does not claim that the focus word alone establishes a complete doctrine of timelessness, nor does it activate the B007 female-camel or milk specializations. The unresolved waw-lam-dal citation in the represented walk remains a qualification, and the wider targets supply no target morphology.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication anchors the B007 reading and the legacy walk preserves its temporal development. The contrast with succession is interpretive and the wider connection rows are discovery evidence, so the finding remains qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sürekli olma, kalma ve yok oluşa rağmen varlığını koruma niteliğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The al-Samad occurrence carries continuance and preservation through change.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The birth and occurrence language in 112:3-4 and the exact al-Qayyum parallels in 2:255 and 3:2 provide a sequence-versus-continuance contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The enduring carrier meets language about generated events and occurrence, so support is perceived as remaining while temporal events are bounded.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Al-Samad reads as enduring support that is not presented as one generated event among successive events.
branch_activations.boundary: No complete timelessness claim, female-camel reading, milk claim, or target-side lexical analysis is asserted.

findings.title: A social analogy opened and bounded
findings.claim: The resort branch permits an intelligible analogy to a superior person sought in affairs, while the supplied lineage and equality boundaries place Allah beyond a class of chiefs with rivals, successors, or peers.
findings.mechanism: The B001 extension facet supplies the social resort image; 112:3-4 and the exact 17:111 boundary remove offspring, partner, and supporting-protector conditions that would make the analogy a peer hierarchy.
findings.reader_payoff: The title becomes understandable through a human resort image while its ordinary social limits are visibly exceeded by the surrounding denials.
findings.containment: The analogy explains how the title becomes intelligible and is not used to place Allah inside a political, tribal, or ranked order. The later denials are contextual boundaries, not a claim that the social image is the literal definition.

epistemic.reason: A trusted publication and a legacy walk preserve the same bounded social analogy. Its application across later denials is an interpretive contextual relation, while the exact wider Arabic is supplied without target morphology.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The named subject and the surrounding lineage and equality boundaries supply the directed need relation that gives the core action a concrete target.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The title first describes directed reliance, then permits the reader to understand its social analogy without confusing the two levels.
branch_activations.boundary: The core action is not reduced to a social rank, and no human political or tribal identity is asserted.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Al-Samad is legible as the one sought in need, with the image extended beyond a class of competing chiefs.
branch_activations.boundary: No political rank, tribal succession, human peer group, or literal social identity is attributed to Allah.

findings.containment: The reader-walk citation to the mercy branch has no registered branch match, so it is used only as contextual qualification; no female-camel, milk, or literal provision facet is activated. This is an attributed contextual resonance, not a definition or causal doctrine.

epistemic.reason: The focus B007 carrier and the contextual relation are supplied by a legacy-unbound walk. The exact carrier is retained, but the mercy contact and stable-provision inference remain explicitly qualified.

findings.title: Fullness and closure as one anti-generation picture
findings.claim: The compact, hollowless facet and the stopper-associated closure together make the paired birth denial perceptible as a passage that has no generative opening to cross.
findings.mechanism: The registered B002 focus carrier supplies compact fullness, the registered B003 carrier supplies closure, and 112:3's active/passive pair independently supplies outward and inward directions; the exact 23:91 text echoes the boundary against divided control and offspring.
findings.reader_payoff: Two related material pressures explain one another: fullness gives the sealed boundary substance, and the stopper gives that boundary an image of closure.
findings.containment: This integrates two related material facets for this finding without turning al-Samad into a physical object or claiming that the material analogy is the literal denotation. The legacy reader source is qualified, and target-side morphology in the wider connection is not inferred.

epistemic.reason: The exact B002 and B003 focus carriers are supplied by the packet, but their joint anti-generation picture is a legacy reader inference. The wider exact text corroborates the boundary without supplying target morphology.

The focus-word alignment resolves both focus words with no unresolved analysis units. The packet's primary floor remains 'Allah, everyone's support'; every retained finding is contained within that recoverable reading.

Unresolved reader citations for rahim, kaf-fa-lam, waw-lam-dal, and kaf-waw-nun remain visible as qualifications. Only registered focus branches are activated from those records.

No independent trigger and changed reader payoff supported an uncandidate activation of root_000047/B002 or root_000882/B004, root_000882/B005, or root_000882/B006. Their availability is left unactivated rather than treated as a negative lexical finding.
